user_agents.name: OAI-SearchBot
user_agents.purpose: Surface websites in search results in ChatGPT search features.
user_agents.scope: ChatGPT search features to surface websites in search answers and navigational links.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow OAI-SearchBot in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: OAI-AdsBot
user_agents.purpose: Validate safety and relevance of web pages submitted as ads on ChatGPT.
user_agents.scope: Only visits web pages submitted as ads on ChatGPT.

user_agents.name: GPTBot
user_agents.purpose: Crawl content used in training generative AI foundation models.
user_agents.scope: Web content for training OpenAI generative AI foundation models.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow GPTBot in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: ChatGPT-User
user_agents.purpose: Perform actions initiated by users in ChatGPT and Custom GPTs.
user_agents.scope: User-initiated requests in ChatGPT, Custom GPTs, and GPT Actions.
user_agents.opt_out: User-initiated; robots.txt rules may not apply.

user_agents.name: ClaudeBot
user_agents.purpose: Collects web content to train and enhance generative AI models.
user_agents.scope: Public web data gathered for model development and training datasets.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow directive in robots.txt under User-agent ClaudeBot.

user_agents.name: Claude-User
user_agents.purpose: Accesses websites to retrieve content in response to user-initiated queries.
user_agents.scope: User-directed web retrieval when individuals ask questions to Claude.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow directive in robots.txt under User-agent Claude-User.

user_agents.name: Claude-SearchBot
user_agents.purpose: Analyzes online content to improve search result relevance and accuracy.
user_agents.scope: Indexing web content specifically for user search optimization.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow directive in robots.txt under User-agent Claude-SearchBot.

user_agents.name: Googlebot
user_agents.purpose: Find information for building Google's search indexes and analysis
user_agents.scope: Google Search, Discover, Google Images, Video mode, and Google News
user_agents.opt_out: Use disallow rules for Googlebot in robots.txt

user_agents.name: Googlebot-Image
user_agents.purpose: Find image content for Google's search indexes
user_agents.scope: Google Images, Discover, Video mode, and Search image features
user_agents.opt_out: Use disallow rules for Googlebot-Image in robots.txt

user_agents.name: Googlebot-Video
user_agents.purpose: Find video content for Google's search indexes
user_agents.scope: Video-related Google Search features and other products dependent on videos
user_agents.opt_out: Use disallow rules for Googlebot-Video in robots.txt

user_agents.name: Googlebot-News
user_agents.purpose: Find content for the Google News product
user_agents.scope: Google News product including news.google.com and the Google News app
user_agents.opt_out: Use disallow rules for Googlebot-News in robots.txt

user_agents.name: Storebot-Google
user_agents.purpose: Crawl for Google Shopping surfaces
user_agents.scope: All surfaces of Google Shopping
user_agents.opt_out: Use disallow rules for Storebot-Google in robots.txt

user_agents.name: Google-InspectionTool
user_agents.purpose: Perform Search testing tools crawls like Rich Result Test and URL inspection
user_agents.scope: Search testing tools in Search Console
user_agents.opt_out: Use disallow rules for Google-InspectionTool in robots.txt

user_agents.name: GoogleOther
user_agents.purpose: Generic crawler for internal research, development, and fetching public content
user_agents.scope: Non-specific product teams and one-off internal crawls
user_agents.opt_out: Use disallow rules for GoogleOther in robots.txt

user_agents.name: GoogleOther-Image
user_agents.purpose: Optimized generic crawler for fetching publicly accessible image URLs
user_agents.scope: Non-specific products fetching publicly accessible image URLs
user_agents.opt_out: Use disallow rules for GoogleOther-Image in robots.txt

user_agents.name: GoogleOther-Video
user_agents.purpose: Optimized generic crawler for fetching publicly accessible video URLs
user_agents.scope: Non-specific products fetching publicly accessible video URLs
user_agents.opt_out: Use disallow rules for GoogleOther-Video in robots.txt

user_agents.name: Google-CloudVertexBot
user_agents.purpose: Crawls requested by site owners for building Vertex AI Agents
user_agents.scope: Vertex AI Agents
user_agents.opt_out: Use disallow rules for Google-CloudVertexBot in robots.txt

user_agents.name: Google-Extended
user_agents.purpose: Manage content use for training Gemini models and grounding Gemini apps
user_agents.scope: Gemini models, Gemini Apps, and Vertex AI Gemini grounding
user_agents.opt_out: Use disallow rules for Google-Extended in robots.txt

user_agents.name: PerplexityBot
user_agents.purpose: Gather and index information from the internet.

user_agents.name: Perplexity-User
user_agents.purpose: Gather and index information from the internet.

user_agents.name: Applebot
user_agents.purpose: Powers search technology across Apple products and services.
user_agents.scope: Crawls web pages to power search technology in Spotlight, Siri, and Safari.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt or use robots meta tags.

user_agents.name: Applebot-Extended
user_agents.purpose: Controls use of crawled data to train Apple generative foundation models.
user_agents.scope: Does not crawl; determines how data crawled by Applebot is used for AI training.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow Applebot-Extended in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: iTMS
user_agents.purpose: Crawls URLs associated with registered content on Apple Podcasts.
user_agents.scope: Only crawls URLs associated with registered content on Apple Podcasts.
user_agents.opt_out: Does not follow robots.txt.

user_agents.name: FacebookExternalHit
user_agents.purpose: Crawls content shared on Meta apps to gather, cache, and display previews.
user_agents.scope: App or website content shared on Facebook, Instagram, or Messenger.
user_agents.opt_out: Add disallow to robots.txt, though security or integrity checks may bypass.

user_agents.name: Meta-WebIndexer
user_agents.purpose: Navigates the web to improve Meta AI search result quality.
user_agents.scope: Online content analyzed to enhance relevance and accuracy of Meta AI.
user_agents.opt_out: Add disallow for the crawler to robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Meta-ExternalAds
user_agents.purpose: Crawls the web to improve advertising and other business-related products.
user_agents.scope: Web content used for advertising and business-related products and services.
user_agents.opt_out: Add disallow for the crawler to robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Meta-ExternalAgent
user_agents.purpose: Crawls the web for training foundation AI models and improving products.
user_agents.scope: Web content used for training foundation AI models or direct indexing.
user_agents.opt_out: Add disallow for the crawler to robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Meta-ExternalFetcher
user_agents.purpose: Fetches individual links at user request and supports agentic AI capabilities.
user_agents.scope: Individual links requested by users to help AI navigate websites.
user_agents.opt_out: May bypass robots.txt because it performs user-requested fetches.

user_agents.name: Amazonbot
user_agents.purpose: Improves Amazon products and services and may train Amazon AI models.
user_agents.scope: Amazon products and services and Amazon AI model training.
user_agents.opt_out: Robots.txt allow/disallow directives and robots meta tags noarchive, noindex, none.

user_agents.name: Amzn-SearchBot
user_agents.purpose: Improves search experiences in Amazon products and services.
user_agents.scope: Search experiences like Alexa; does not crawl for generative AI model training.
user_agents.opt_out: Robots.txt directives and page-level robots meta tags.

user_agents.name: Amzn-User
user_agents.purpose: Supports user actions such as responding to Alexa queries with live information.
user_agents.scope: Fetches live information on user's behalf; not for generative AI model training.
user_agents.opt_out: May not follow all robots.txt directives because actions are initiated by users.

user_agents.name: CCBot
user_agents.purpose: Automated web crawler providing a copy of the Internet for research and analysis.
user_agents.scope: A randomly selected subset of the web stored for open research and analysis.
user_agents.opt_out: Set Disallow: / in robots.txt for User-agent CCBot or request addition to opt-out registry.
